local_authorized.note: Only import images owned by the project or covered by explicit written permission.

openverse.note: Provider metadata is not a legal guarantee. Review license, attribution, model and property rights before production use.

wikimedia_commons.note: Use the Wikimedia Commons API only. Keep provider-declared public-domain records pending until source, license, model and property rights are manually reviewed.

flickr.note: Use the official Flickr API with safe_search and public-domain license filters. Requires FLICKR_API_KEY. Review source, license, model and property rights before production use.

instagram.note: Do not scrape feeds, profiles, stories, or login-gated content. Import only files covered by explicit written permission through local_authorized.

tiktok.note: Do not scrape feeds, profiles, videos, or login-gated content. Import only files covered by explicit written permission through local_authorized.

xiaohongshu.note: Do not scrape feeds, notes, user pages, or login-gated content. Import only files covered by explicit written permission through local_authorized.

weibo.note: Do not scrape feeds, posts, user pages, or login-gated content. Import only files covered by explicit written permission through local_authorized.

unsplash.note: Current API terms direct ML/AI uses to Unsplash data licensing. Do not collect through the ordinary API for this project.

pexels.note: Current terms prohibit unauthorized ML extraction and large-scale copying.
